methodologyNotes: Roster covers 12 corded and cordless jigsaws spanning entry-level to professional tiers. Each product was independently re-verified against manufacturer product pages (Bosch, DeWalt, Makita, Milwaukee, Festool, Metabo HPT, Ryobi, Black+Decker, Skil) and live US retailer/distributor listings (Home Depot, Lowes, Amazon, Coastal Tool, Tool Nut, Ohio Power Tool, Acme Tools, CPO Outlets, Farrell Equipment). Prices reflect current US retail or MSRP found on live pages as of 2026-06-20; 'tool only'/bare-tool prices are used where both kit and bare-tool SKUs exist. Booleans indicate presence (true) or absence (false) of the feature; null means the specification (or a published US price) could not be confirmed in any source consulted. Adversarial corrections in this pass: Makita 4350FCT price 269->309 (real retail) and orbital_settings 4->3 (Makita specs three orbital settings); Makita XVJ03Z orbital_settings 4->3; Black+Decker BDEJS600C price 31.80->39.99 (Home Depot/Amazon); Festool PSB 420 bevel null->45 (±45° via Angle Base); Metabo HPT CJ110MV price 99->null (no published US price confirmable, only CAD 99 and a different CJ110MVA variant). Note: Festool Carvex PSB 420 EBQ-Plus (576192) is listed discontinued by several retailers as of early 2025 but still sells at full $445 MSRP on others (e.g. Farrell Equipment). accessedAt 2026-06-20.

products.name: Bosch JS470E Top-Handle Jig Saw
products.priceNote: Tool only with carrying case; retail varies $120 (Home Depot) to $209 (CPO). $179 is a mid-market authorized-dealer price.
products.provenance: Specs confirmed on Bosch US product page and corroborated at MSC Industrial and CPO: 7.0 A, 500-3,100 SPM, 1 in stroke, 4 orbital settings, 45° bevel, tool-less T-shank blade change, ~5.9 lb. Price is dispersed: Home Depot ~$119-120, CPO $209, MSC/Amazon mid-range; $179 retained as a representative authorized-dealer tool-only price.

products.name: Bosch JS572EBL Barrel-Grip Jig Saw
products.priceNote: Bare tool price; kit (JS572EBK) retails higher
products.provenance: Corded 120 V / 7.2 A barrel-grip jigsaw (not 18 V cordless). Specs (7.2 A, 800-3,000 SPM, 1 in stroke, 4 orbital, 45° bevel, tool-less blade change, Precision Control II double-roller) confirmed via Bosch JS572EBK page, ToolBoxBuzz review, and Lowes/Home Depot listings. Release year ~2012 per Tool-Rank announcement. $289 bare-tool price is plausible but soft; kit (JS572EBK) is the more widely stocked SKU.

products.name: DeWalt DCS334B 20V MAX XR Cordless Jig Saw
products.priceNote: Tool only, battery and charger sold separately; street range ~$179-239
products.provenance: Specs confirmed on DeWalt US page: 20 V, brushless motor, 4-position orbital, bevel detents 0/15/30/45° (45° stop), lever-action keyless T-shank blade change, 0-3,200 SPM, 1 in stroke. Tool-only price varies (Ohio Power Tool $239, Walmart/Amazon higher, sale prices lower); $195 retained as a mid-market tool-only price within the observed band.

products.name: DeWalt DW331K Jig Saw Kit
products.provenance: Specs confirmed on DeWalt page and Home Depot/Ace listings: 6.5 A, 500-3,100 SPM (some catalogs round to 3,000), 4-position orbital, all-metal bevel detents 0/15/30/45°, lever-action keyless blade clamp, 1 in (26 mm) stroke. ~$193.99 kit price within observed retail range.

products.name: Makita XVJ03Z 18V LXT Cordless Jig Saw
products.provenance: Specs confirmed on Makita USA page: 18 V LXT, 0-2,600 SPM, 1 in stroke, THREE orbital settings plus straight cutting, bevel 0-45° left or right, tool-less blade change lever, brushed motor, LED. CORRECTED orbital_settings 4->3 to match Makita's published 'three orbital settings' (the draft counted straight as a fourth). $199 bare-tool price seen at ToolUp/Acme as list; street drops to ~$130-140 on some channels.

products.name: Makita 4350FCT Top-Handle Jig Saw
products.provenance: Specs confirmed on Makita USA page: 6.3 A, 800-2,800 SPM, 1 in stroke, THREE orbital settings plus straight, bevel 0-45° both sides, tool-less blade change, built-in LED, 5.7 lb. CORRECTED price 269->309: draft's $269 'Home Depot' figure is unverifiable; live US retail clusters at $299-309 (Walmart $309.06, McCoys $306.30, eBay ~$299). CORRECTED orbital_settings 4->3 to match Makita's 'three orbital settings'.

products.name: Milwaukee M18 FUEL D-Handle Jig Saw (2737-20)
products.priceNote: Tool only, battery and charger sold separately
products.provenance: Specs confirmed via Milwaukee product data and Ohio Power Tool / Tool Nut listings: 18 V, POWERSTATE brushless motor, 0-3,500 SPM, 1 in stroke, 4-position orbital, tool-free bevel detents 0/15/30/45°, Quik-Lok tool-less T-shank blade change, ~4.85 lb tool only. Source URL switched from the 2737-21 kit page to the 2737-20 bare-tool listing. Price $229 (tool only) confirmed at Tool Nut and Ohio Power Tool.

products.name: Festool Carvex PSB 420 EBQ-Plus Jig Saw
products.priceNote: MSRP; model 576192 listed discontinued by some retailers as of early 2025 but still sold at $445 full price (e.g. Farrell Equipment). A 2024 Rockler clearance hit $254.99.
products.provenance: Real product (D-handle Carvex PSB 420 EBQ-Plus, 576192). Specs confirmed: 4.5 A / 120 V, 1,500-3,800 SPM, 1 in (26 mm) stroke, 4-stage pendulum/orbital adjustment, EC-TEC brushless motor, tool-free key blade change, ~4.2 lb. CORRECTED bevel_capacity_deg null->45: Festool/Acme spec the Carvex base adjustable ±45° for inside/outside corners. Price $445 MSRP confirmed live at Farrell Equipment; multiple retailers flag SKU discontinued as of 2025, and a 2024 Rockler clearance reached $254.99 — full price retained as the current MSRP.

products.name: Ryobi P5231 18V ONE+ Cordless Orbital Jig Saw
products.priceNote: Tool only, battery not included; Home Depot retail price
products.provenance: Specs confirmed from Ryobi P5231 operator's manual and Home Depot/Walmart listings: 18 V ONE+, 0/1,100-3,000 SPM, 1 in stroke, 4 orbital settings, bevel 0-45° left and right, tool-free blade clamp, brushed motor, ~4.4 lb. Source URL switched from a ManualsLib manual to the Home Depot retail listing (more topical). $69 tool-only price confirmed at Home Depot and Walmart. Ryobi.com now marks the SKU discontinued (superseded by ONE+ HP brushless), but it remains stocked at retail at $69.

products.name: Black+Decker BDEJS600C 5-Amp Jig Saw
products.priceNote: Current Home Depot / Amazon retail price
products.provenance: Specs confirmed on Black+Decker page and Home Depot/Amazon/Lowes listings: 5.0 A, 0-3,000 SPM, 4 CurveControl orbit settings, 45° bevel, 3/4 in stroke, keyless blade change, ~5.4 lb. CORRECTED price 31.80->39.99: live Home Depot and Amazon both list $39.99 (camelcamelcamel confirms ~$39 historical); draft's $31.80 is below the standing retail price.

products.name: Metabo HPT CJ110MV Variable Speed Jig Saw
products.priceNote: No current published US price confirmable. Only a Canadian CAD $99 (Mississauga Hardware) and a different CJ110MVA variant at $170.75 were found; the corded CJ110MV is being phased out and is sporadically stocked at US retail.
products.provenance: Specs confirmed on Metabo HPT page and Lowes listing: 5.8 A, 850-3,000 SPM, 1 in stroke, 4-stage orbital, bevel ±45° left/right, tool-less blade change, LED light, ~4.9 lb, cast aluminum base. CORRECTED price 99->null: the draft's $99 came from a Canadian listing (CAD $99) and unverified snippets; no live published US dollar price for the exact CJ110MV could be confirmed (a different CJ110MVA variant lists at $170.75). A null beats a guess.

products.name: Skil JS820301 PWRCore 20V Cordless Jigsaw
products.priceNote: Bare-tool US price not published; kit version JS820302 (with 2.0Ah battery and charger) lists at $89.99
products.provenance: Specs for JS820301 and its kit sibling JS820302 confirmed from Skil's product page and Amazon/ToolOrbit listings: 20 V PWRCore, 0-2,800 SPM, 7/8 in (22 mm) stroke, 4-stage orbital function, tool-free blade clamp and bevel. Non-brushless; the brushless sibling is the separate JS820202 (confirmed at Acme/Skil). Bare-tool US dollar price is not published; $89.99 is the confirmed kit price for JS820302, so priceUsd kept null for the bare-tool SKU.
